items.title: Prospective Assessment of Nasal Airway Function After Primary Open Rhinoplasty
items.fact_zh: 32例美容开鼻鼻整形3个月，PNIF 76.9→86.2，NOSE 23.4→14.3，鼻塞感略差。
items.take_zh: 功能没变差、反而改善；但客观气流与患者感受互不相关，别拿PNIF替病人说话。
items.scene_zh: 做完鼻子气更顺了，可你舒不舒服，跟仪器测的不一定一致。
items.fact_en: In 32 aesthetic-only open rhinoplasties, PNIF rose from 76.9 to 86.2 L/min and NOSE fell from 23.4 to 14.3 at 3 months, though the nasal-fullness item worsened slightly.
items.take_en: Airway function was preserved and even improved, but objective airflow and patient-reported scores did not correlate, so neither can stand in for the other.

items.title: A Single Rib Integrated Scaffold for Semiopen Revision Rhinoplasty After Nasolabial Flap
items.fact_zh: 20例鼻唇沟皮瓣后翻修，四段肋软骨支架经双侧鼻翼缘送入，12个月ROE 48.5→88.2。
items.take_zh: 瘢痕挛缩做不了常规开放式时，这条路走得通；单术者20例，只算可行，不算优选。
items.scene_zh: 之前做过皮瓣、鼻子里面全是疤的，可以分四块从鼻翼缘送进去拼。
items.fact_en: In 20 revision cases after nasolabial flap, a four-component rib scaffold delivered through bilateral alar rim incisions raised ROE from 48.5 to 88.2 at 12 months with no infection or extrusion.
items.take_en: A workable route when scar contracture makes the standard open approach hazardous, but this single-surgeon series of 20 establishes feasibility, not superiority.

items.title: Prevention of Secondary Deformities at the Donor Site After Cartilage Transplantation
items.fact_zh: 92例耳软骨取材随访6–18个月：45例无畸形、41例轻度、6例明显未修、0例重度。
items.take_zh: 供区畸形能压到轻中度，但“轻度”占四成多；别跟病人保证耳朵外形一点不变。
items.scene_zh: 取耳软骨耳朵会有点变形，多数很轻，但我不敢说一点没有。
items.fact_en: Among 92 auricular cartilage harvests followed 6 to 18 months, 45 ears had no deformity, 41 mild deformity, 6 noticeable but unrevised, and none severe.
items.take_en: Modified incision and harvest sites keep donor-site deformity mild at worst, but with 45% mild contour change, promise patients nothing better than that.

items.title: Postoperative nausea and vomiting after facelift surgery despite routine dual antiemetic prophylaxis
items.fact_zh: 220例拉皮，96%用了地塞米松+昂丹司琼，仍62.3%发生恶心呕吐，49%呕吐，住院多9小时。
items.take_zh: 拉皮加眼睑、手术时间长，PONV风险明显升高；Apfel评分在这里不灵，双药预防不够。
items.scene_zh: 拉皮加双眼皮一起做、时间又长的，术后吐的概率很高，止吐得提前加码。
items.fact_en: In 220 facelifts with 96% receiving dexamethasone plus ondansetron, PONV still occurred in 62.3%, vomiting in 49%, and hospital stay was 9 hours longer.
items.take_en: Concurrent blepharoplasty (OR 5.67) and longer operative time drove PONV while the Apfel score failed to predict it, so dual prophylaxis is not enough in combined long cases.

items.title: The Transumbilical Breast Augmentation: Safety and Satisfaction in a Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of 13,210 Breasts
items.fact_zh: 17项研究、6605人：经脐隆胸血肿0.2%、包膜挛缩1.7%、再干预2.3%，手术约60分钟。
items.take_zh: 数字漂亮，但几乎全是单臂回顾、随访短，只能证明“能做”，不能证明优于腋下或乳晕。
items.scene_zh: 肚脐做隆胸疤藏得好，报告并发症也低，可没人拿它跟别的入路正面比过。
items.fact_en: Across 17 studies and 6,605 patients, transumbilical augmentation showed pooled hematoma 0.2%, capsular contracture 1.7%, and reintervention 2.3%, with a median 60-minute operative time.
items.take_en: The low complication rates come almost entirely from retrospective single-arm series with short follow-up, so they support feasibility, not equivalence to axillary or periareolar access.

items.title: Five-Year Clinical Performance and Patient-Reported Outcomes of Mentor MemoryGel and MemoryShape Breast Implants (GLOW Study)
items.take_zh: 0.31%不能读成解剖型更安全，研究没做头对头；但“五年约二十分之一再手术”可以拿去谈话。
items.scene_zh: 五年内大概二十分之一要再上一次手术台，这个数先讲清楚再谈假体形状。
items.fact_en: At 5 years in primary augmentation, Baker III/IV contracture was 0.31% with MemoryShape, 1.42% with MemoryGel Xtra, and 5.16% with MemoryGel; reoperation for implant-related reasons was 2.9% to 5.5%.
items.take_en: The study was not powered for device comparison, so the anatomical implant's 0.31% is not evidence of superiority; the 5-year reoperation rate near 1 in 20 is the number worth quoting.
